prospective_repair.finding: V4 mean/variance-rescale-only SO/spindle event veto was named but not numerically executable.
prospective_repair.resolution: V5 freezes exact paired raw-trace inputs, intervention-to-sham affine moment normalization, degenerate and nonfinite branches, unchanged sham detector thresholds, three-way SO/spindle matching and ordering, per-block and context pooling, hard-veto and NOT_ESTIMABLE logic, nonrecursive record hashes, exact logs and a self-contained data-free oracle.
prospective_repair.identity_resolution: V5 also freezes deterministic identities for all 50 Level-A conditions and 1,800 runs plus complete Level-A, Level-B cached-sham, T6/T7 reuse, and verifier sham aliases; these name existing physical trajectories and create no new run.
prospective_repair.bootstrap_clarification: Undefined or all-missing point-estimable bootstrap members yield a fail-closed NOT_ESTIMABLE family with no imputation, redraw, retry or numeric band; T4 zero-added remains the sole explicit exception.
